candidates.title: Interactive Pet Customization Live Preview Screen
candidates.change: Add a new interactive pet preview screen where users can see their pet react in real-time before finalizing customization.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% with a high mean time of 1017s, and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.

new_pet_preview.headline: Meet Your New Companion
new_pet_preview.body: Preview how your pet looks and reacts on your desktop before official adoption.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an interactive preview screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops sharply to 60.9%; live preview fixes generation issues but requires building a new screen.

candidates.title: Live Hatching Stage Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a dynamic visual stage layout showing real-time desktop environment preparation steps and animated progress.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on the desktop after onboarding.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's New Desktop Habitat
waiting.body: Setting up desktop overlays, tray controls, and custom pet animations...

guard.reason: Redesign retains the waiting screen functionality and required elements.

candidates.score_note: High wait time on home screen backed by support tickets; visual redesign improves perceived wait time.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Guided Walkthrough
candidates.change: Add an interactive step-by-step checklist screen during completion that teaches users how to summon, move, and hide their desktop pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, contributing to a drop at the finish step (64.8%).

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home! Let's Try Your Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Learn how to summon, drag, and interact with your pet on your desktop.

new_controls_tutorial.headline: Quick Desktop Pet Checklist
new_controls_tutorial.body: Try moving your pet or opening the tray menu right now.

components.text: Click and drag pet across screen
Right click pet to open control menu

guard.reason: Adding a tutorial screen after home intro inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has a large 35.2% drop with 3 support mails; interactive walkthrough eases setup confusion.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In to Final Onboarding Step
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to the very end of onboarding, after home_intro, so users experience their live desktop pet before creating/linking an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently stalls or confuses users, and 8 support emails noted accounts/pets resetting when signing in early or improperly.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet & Sync Across Devices
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet's adoption progress and settings.

guard.reason: home_intro must come after every existing screen, sign_in included

candidates.title: Sign-In Stalling Safeguard & Direct Support Link
candidates.change: Add a troubleshooting hint and alternative email sign-in button on the sign-in screen if loading stalls or authentication delays.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen not appearing or stalling before completion.

sign_in.hint: Taking longer than expected? Tap below to retry or request a sign-in magic link.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.button_label' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Desktop Habitat Loading Diagnostic Status
candidates.change: Add dynamic wait info hints on the waiting screen explaining display overlay permissions and desktop compatibility checks.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open during the home waiting phase.

waiting.hint: Ensuring desktop overlay permissions are active so your pet can roam freely on your screen.

guard.reason: Adding status diagnostic info to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adding dynamic diagnostic status during long load times reliably reduces drop-offs with low cost.

candidates.title: Grid Card Layout for Path Choice Selection
candidates.change: Display path choices as large visual grid cards with pet animations to help users decide quickly.
candidates.why: choose_path conversion drops to 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion's Origin
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-adopt desktop pet or create a custom pet from your photo.

candidates.title: Official Adoption Certificate Starter Perks Badge
candidates.change: Add an adoption reward badge and starter item bonus directly on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with median 89s / mean 1017s; explicit incentives motivate completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Complete adoption to unlock exclusive starter pet toys and bonus custom background accessories!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions bonus gifts and free starter extras, violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Interactive System Tray & Control Dock Tutorial Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated visual onboarding screen demonstrating system tray docking and right-click pet interactions.
candidates.why: 3 users contacted support confused about how to hide, control, or converse with their desktop pet after completing setup.

new_dock_guide.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Dock
new_dock_guide.body: Your pet lives in your system tray! Click the pet anytime to open quick controls.

guard.reason: Adding a system tray tutorial screen after home intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses finish drop-off and control confusion, but adding a full tutorial screen may introduce friction.

candidates.title: Path Choice Reassurance & Quick Start Copy
candidates.change: Update story screen headline and body copy to clarify that users can customize or switch pets anytime after onboarding.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s, indicating hesitation and decision paralysis.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey
story.body: Pick any path to get started immediately. You can always change pets or customize new ones later!

guard.reason: Updating story screen copy maintains its core introductory job.

candidates.score_note: High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation; copy reassurance is zero-engineering cost with proven effectiveness.
